requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of the arrest or citation, exactly as the arrest record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of the arrest or citation, exactly as the arrest record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the eligibility clock runs from a date on the participant's own arrest record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the arrest or citation date, copied exactly - the recorded twelve-month clock runs from it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Arrest, citation, or booking number, if one appears on the arrest record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Arrest, citation, or booking number, if one appears on the arrest record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no record identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the arrest, citation, or booking number, copied from the arrest record if one appears there

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name of the agency that made the arrest or issued the citation
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name of the agency that made the arrest or issued the citation
requiredBeforeFiling.why: an agency name is a case fact the participant can obtain, not a field the court owns
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the agency that made the arrest or issued the citation, from the arrest record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption - the court with jurisdiction over the matter, and its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption - the court with jurisdiction over the matter, and its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which court has jurisdiction over an uncharged arrest is a fact of the participant's matter, and no committed record resolves it further
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the court with jurisdiction over the matter, and its county or city - that court's own office can confirm both

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Misdemeanor offense for which the petitioner was arrested, cited, or held, worded exactly as the arrest record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Misdemeanor offense for which the petitioner was arrested, cited, or held, worded exactly as the arrest record words it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no offense fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the misdemeanor offense, worded exactly as the arrest record words it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case number in the caption of the proposed order, if one was assigned
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case number in the caption of the proposed order, if one was assigned
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number, if the court assigned one at filing

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court named in the caption of the proposed order, and its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court named in the caption of the proposed order, and its county or city
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the proposed order travels with the petition and carries the same caption the participant establishes
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same court name and county or city you wrote in the petition's caption

protectedBlanks.label: Case number of this petition, if the court assigns one at filing
protectedBlanks.why: if a number is assigned, the court assigns it at filing

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the petitioner on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: the petitioner signs the petition personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the petitioner's signature on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the petition is signed would be false

protectedBlanks.label: The decision line of the proposed order, decided by the court
protectedBlanks.why: every decision on the proposed order is the court's

protectedBlanks.label: Signature line of the proposed order, for the court
protectedBlanks.why: the court signs the order if, and only if, it grants the petition

protectedBlanks.label: Date line of the proposed order, for the court
protectedBlanks.why: the court dates the order when it decides
